FXVolatilities|TimeInterpolation.reason: The FX volatility config reads TimeInterpolation as one of the time-interpolation codes, and this is the parser that accepts them. The name also appears under CapFloorVolatilities, which is not linked here because its time interpolation is a different code.

InflationCurves|Frequency.reason: Only the inflation curve config carries a Frequency leaf, and ORE reads it with this parser.

YieldCurves|ExtrapolationMethod.reason: Only the yield curve config carries ExtrapolationMethod, and ORE parses its accessor with this function.

YieldCurves|InterpolationMethod.reason: Only the yield curve config's InterpolationMethod is parsed by this function (yieldcurve.cpp:505). Equity, inflation, commodity and cap floor volatility configs carry a leaf of the same name, but ORE states no list for them here, so they stay text rather than take a list that is not theirs.

YieldCurves|InterpolationVariable.reason: Parsed by this function for the yield curve config only; the other families carry the name without an ORE list.
